segments.text: Welcome! Ever wondered why Jesus, in His most profound hour,
chose the quiet solitude of Gethsemane over the grandeur of the Temple?
It’s a question that touches the very heart of His mission.
While the Temple represented outward worship and communal gathering,
Gethsemane was a place of deep, personal communion.
It was there, amidst the olive trees,
that Jesus faced His ultimate test, not in a public spectacle,
but in a private struggle of will and love.
it was about the raw, vulnerable surrender of His spirit to the Father’s will.
Gethsemane reveals a Jesus who sought intimacy with God,
a connection forged in quiet prayer and profound obedience,
often blossoms in the unseen moments of personal devotion.
Thank you for joining me on this reflection.
If you found this insightful, consider following for more explorations.
